result.planSummary: Implemented Story 1’s conversation-only lower-band turn projection service, added exact projection token-count helpers, surfaced prepare-mode smooth catch-up warnings/failure wording, and covered the new behavior with projection, async-thread, and token-accounting tests.

changedFiles.reason: Added the conversation-only turn projection service with deterministic projection materialization, exact-count persistence, and stale-write protection.
Added visible prepare-mode smooth catch-up stderr warnings and clearer compact-preparation failure messages when smooth repair cannot recover a turn.
Added heuristic counting support for conversation-only turn lower-band projection text.
Added exact OpenAI input-token counting support for conversation-only turn lower-band projections.
Added Story 1 service coverage for projection sourcing, markers, exclusions, user-only turns, invalid/pending states, persistence, exact-count failure, and stale-writer safety.
Added prepare-mode coverage for visible smooth catch-up warnings and specific failure messaging when catch-up cannot repair a turn.
Added coverage for the new lower-band projection materialized count scope.
Added coverage for exact OpenAI counting of lower-band projection text.

findingsFixed: Prevented stale lower-band projection writes from overwriting fresher persisted projection state by rejecting older projection snapshots.
Made prepare-mode smooth catch-up attempts operator-visible on stderr and upgraded unrepaired smooth blockers to explicit compact-preparation failure wording.
Ensured ready projections reuse persisted exact provider-input counts instead of re-counting unchanged smooth state.

result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to Story 2 by switching chunk eligibility and chunk transcript assembly from smooth-turn counts/text to the new persisted conversation-only turn projection state.
